topography.project_purpose: Symbiosis is an active cross-chain bridge and liquidity protocol that enables users to swap and transfer assets across multiple blockchains. The currently analyzed contract inventory should be treated as a limited discovered subset, not the full live protocol surface; staking, pools, relayers, depository, TON/non-EVM integrations, and supported EVM-chain deployments may be out of scope unless separately inventoried.
topography.relationship_narrative: The Symbiosis family relies on Portal contracts as the main entry points for cross-chain operations, with MetaRouter handling routing logic and WOFTAdapterFactory managing token adapters. Supporting proxy contracts provide upgradeability and access control, while verifier contracts ensure transaction integrity.
